summary: The verified Graphify integration is active in both user-approved checkouts, and both remote refs equal their local branch tips.
findings: Real indexed Writer and Calc symbol queries returned exact source lines. The graphs have different file identities and matched their individual roots. Existing Calc output was preserved and excluded.
residual_risks: The sibling checkout SSH authentication failed and HTTPS was used for this verification. Existing pre-push hook is not executable. Graphify reported partial parsing for eight existing files.
